proposed_value: different cell types, different assay formats, different sequence lengths
rationale:
- The paper describes MPRA experiments in mouse embryonic stem cells (a second cell type) alongside human ExP-STARR-seq data, indicating different cell types were tested.
- It notes differences in assay format (MPRA vs. STARR-seq), plasmid design, and element selection method, implying different experimental conditions.
- The study explicitly mentions differences in enhancer and promoter sequence lengths (about 400 bp in MPRA vs. unspecified in ExP-STARR-seq), confirming variation in sequence length as a tested condition.
